clone_disance

Source: R/clone_dis.R
clone_disance.Rd

Compute Clone-to-Clone Distances from Cell Embedding and Clone Assignments

Usage

clone_disance(
  embedding,
  cell_clone_prob,
  outpath,
  graph_k = 10,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  exact = FALSE,
  force_exact = FALSE,
  exact_cell_limit = 20000L,
  exact_clone_limit = 500L,
  exact_backend = c("disk", "memory"),
  revised = TRUE,
  clone_labels = NULL,
  sample = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

embedding

A numeric matrix of cell embeddings (cells × dimensions).

cell_clone_prob

A numeric matrix of clone membership probabilities (cells × clones).

outpath

File path to save and load intermediate graph and distance results.

graph_k

Integer. Number of neighbors to use in the SNN graph (default: 10).

overwrite

Logical. Whether to overwrite previously saved graphs and results (default: FALSE).

exact

Logical. If `TRUE`, computes exact OT-based clone distances with the disk-backed implementation by default; otherwise, uses approximate NN (default: FALSE).

exact_backend

Exact-OT implementation. "disk" (default) writes a resumable cell-distance store and reads bounded cost blocks. "memory" retains the legacy dense in-memory implementation for small reproductions.

force_exact

Logical. Allow exact mode to proceed when the input exceeds the conservative cell or clone safety limits (default: `FALSE`).

exact_cell_limit, exact_clone_limit

Conservative safety limits used to warn before an exact calculation that is likely to require substantial runtime or memory.

revised

Logical. If `TRUE` (the default), optionally locally rescales the raw Clonotrace distance and blends it with clone-centroid distance using a fate-blind automatically selected weight; see `revise_clone_distance()`. Local rescaling is off by default and can be enabled with `local_rescale = TRUE`. Set `FALSE` to return the original exact-OT or approximate distance.

clone_labels

Optional observed clone membership used for clone centroids, as a data frame with columns `cell` and `clone`, or a vector named by cell. If `NULL`, `cell_clone_prob` supplies probability weights.

sample

Optional clone-level grouping, such as patient, passed to `revise_clone_distance()` so normalization and weight selection use within-group clone pairs.

...

Named arguments passed to graph_clone_ot_disk() (disk exact), graph_clone_ot() (legacy memory exact), or graph_clone_nn(), and—when revised = TRUE—to `revise_clone_distance()` (`local_k`, `local_rescale`, `resolutions`, `clusters`, `cluster_k`, `mean_weight`, `s_grid`, `seed`, and `verbose`).

Value

A data frame with columns `group1`, `group2`, and `dis`. With `revised = TRUE`, `dis` is the revised distance, `dis_clonotrace` retains the raw distance, and attributes `mean_weight` and `picks` record the automatic blend. With `revised = FALSE`, `dis` is the raw distance.

Details

Constructs a cell-cell shared nearest neighbor (SNN) graph from an embedding and uses it to estimate pairwise distances between clones. Exact mode uses a resumable disk-backed shortest-path store by default; the legacy dense in-memory backend remains available explicitly. Users can alternatively select the faster approximate k-nearest-neighbor distance.
